scope: Modular sketch references only, no Blender models
source_boxes_status: Direct visible-front region guides; not object masks or measured building dimensions
section_connections: Stack S01→S02→S03→S04, centred on the same faceted core. J1 plinth top/shaft foot; J2 shaft head/collar underside; J3 collar top/roof underside. Slim front face remains aligned. Lantern seat positions are separate attachment surfaces on S02.

parts.name: Tapered petal plinth
parts.description: Small faceted base flaring gently from slim shaft, ivory and rose triangular petal panels with blue/lilac glass inset and floral gold edging. Neighboring plants and walls excluded.

parts.name: Slender star-glass shaft
parts.description: Long very slim faceted shaft with blue and pink vertical glass lights, slender white marble engaged ribs and two spaced gold star emblems. Preserve length and source narrowness, not a broad solid tube. Lantern arms are separate fittings.

parts.name: Needle clerestory collar
parts.description: Short shallow arched crown collar above the main shaft, tiny blue lancets with slim ivory supports and gold ledges, small source side pinnacles where they spring from this collar.

parts.name: Steep violet needle crown
parts.description: Long steep violet conical/faceted spire with fine gold ribs, tiny gold side finials at eave, long thin star-tipped spindle. Preserve the sharp slender taper, never an onion dome.

decor.name: Shaft lancet frame
decor.description: One very tall slim pointed ivory/gold surround with clean mounting back.

decor.name: Vertical gold mullion
decor.description: One narrow gold leading rib for the long glass shaft, complete ends.

decor.name: Star-glass insert
decor.description: One blue/pink lancet glass tile with the source elongated gold star, separate from surround.

decor.name: Slender engaged shaft pier
decor.description: One slender ivory marble fluted pier with a modest leaf head and flat rear.

decor.name: Lancet shoulder impost
decor.description: Small gold-edged ivory lotus head where tall pointed windows spring.

decor.name: Triangular plinth face
decor.description: One faceted rose/ivory base panel with blue violet inset and petal gold edge.

decor.name: Petal base relief
decor.description: Small white/gold floral-petal relief from tapered plinth.

decor.name: Shaft foot leaf clamp
decor.description: Tiny gold leaf surround at the shaft foot, no mechanical bolt.

decor.name: Crown arch surround
decor.description: One small pointed clerestory open surround matching the needle collar.

decor.name: Collar cornice repeat
decor.description: Short gently faceted ivory/gold collar cornice, matching seam ends.

decor.name: Facet corner cap
decor.description: Small marble corner return with fine gold bands.

decor.name: Steep roof rib
decor.description: One complete thin tapered gold rib shaped for the steep needle, not a curved bulb rib.

decor.name: Needle eave crocket
decor.description: Small gold leaf crest at spire eave, isolated.

decor.name: Spindle neck socket
decor.description: Delicate architectural gold knop/socket under the existing shared star finial.

decor.name: Pinnacle attachment corbel
decor.description: Small ivory/gold seat for a subsidiary pencil pinnacle on crown collar.

decor.name: Lantern mount collar
decor.description: The needle-specific carved gold collar mounted to the slim pier, cage/arm reused from terminal kit.

prompts.structure_correction: Edit R01 only: remove invented second tier of open arches and dangling feet from S03, retaining one shallow clerestory collar. Other parts and captions unchanged.
prompts.decor_correction: Correct this 16-cell palace needle-tower decor sheet. Preserve the 4-by-4 grid, every exact printed ID and part name, and source ivory/rose marble, blue/pink glass, gold palette. Use clean nearly frontal technical reference views with simple readable silhouettes and no ornamental warping. CRITICAL D12 Steep roof rib is wrong: remove its whole cone, roof faces, circular base and star. Replace it with ONE SINGLE very thin straight gently tapered gold meridian strip, seen as an isolated long narrow rod, plain complete top and bottom, no other ribs or panels. D16 Lantern mount collar: simplify to a small gold half-collar/socket on a short curved support with a flat wall plate; remove the invented huge lotus pedestal and long arm. D05 Lancet shoulder impost: keep a small restrained ivory/gold leaf capital without a hanging ornamental spike. D01/D04/D09 keep clean regular thin straight shafts and balanced pointed arches, no twisting or leaning columns. All motifs on other cells stay source-compatible and recognizable, remove irregular extra curls rather than inventing detail. One component per cell only, full silhouette and mounting ends visible; do not turn a detail into an assembly. All sixteen item captions remain unchanged and legible, no empty cells and no cropped assets.
